name: arc-local
description: Language servers for this repo, each one the same tool the build type-checks with

plugins.name: pyrefly-lsp
plugins.description: Python language server backed by pyrefly — the same type checker just typecheck and CI run, so editor diagnostics never disagree with the build

plugins.name: tsgo-lsp
plugins.description: TypeScript language server backed by tsgo — the same compiler just typecheck and CI run, so editor diagnostics never disagree with the build
